concepts_intro: Concepts are what the course teaches. Approved concepts and their links to activities give you and your learners a mastery map.
concepts_empty: The course has no approved concepts yet.
concepts_empty_editor: No concepts yet. AI will suggest them from the course material, or add your own.
concepts_tag_remove_consequence: AI may suggest this link again; reject it to prevent that.
concepts_tag_weight_hint: How much the activity exercises the concept: 1 means fully.
concepts_prerequisites_hint: What to master before this concept.
concepts_delete_consequence: Its links to activities and its prerequisites are deleted too.
concepts_class_intro: How many learners are at each level of the approved concepts, and who is behind.
concepts_class_empty: The map appears once the course has approved concepts.
concepts_class_off: The concept map is turned off by an admin.
concepts_mine_intro: How well you have mastered the course concepts, judging by your answers. Start with the ones you struggle with.
concepts_search_label: What to find in the material
concepts_search_off: Material search is turned off by an admin.
